manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Changeling Berserker, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Yannik until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
